verdict.rationale: Floot mentions a 'development preview' you can send, separate from publishing the live app (floot-docs-32, floot-docs-22), and checkpoints that can be restored after a bad change (floot-docs-5, floot-docs-25). That hints at a pre-production workflow with rollback, but nothing says the preview uses data isolated from the production database, and the AI's execute_sql writes appear to hit the managed Postgres directly (floot-docs-4, floot-docs-17). missing for 10: documented separate dev/staging database or sandbox environment, explicit isolation of test data from production, agent-scoped sandbox for MCP tool calls, independent corroboration.
